title: Vino 50 (Enduro Spec)
description: Representing Yamaha's prowess in the Urban Roadster class, the Yamaha Vino 50 (Enduro Spec) is delivers muscular mid-range acceleration paired with effortless city maneuvering. A 50cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
